# std.records

Typed record operations.

## Types

### `Extends`

```badger
protocol Extends {  }
```

`S: Extends<T>`: every field of record `T` is present in `S` at the same
type. Solved structurally by the compiler.

### `Projects`

```badger
protocol Projects {  }
```

`S: Projects<T>`: `S` has every field of `T` at the same type, so the
closed subset `T` can be projected out. Solved by the compiler.
